cues.text: 这地方闻起来像柴油、雨水和坏决定。
cues.textEn: The place smelled of diesel, rain, and bad decisions.

cues.text: 铁轨边堆着几台拆了一半的机器，像几具没人愿意认领的尸体。
cues.textEn: Half dismantled machines lay beside the tracks like bodies nobody wanted to claim.

cues.text: 酒馆门口有三个工人，他们本来在笑。看见我的西服以后，笑声就像被人掐断了电。
cues.textEn: Three workers were laughing outside the tavern. One look at my suit, and the laughter died.

cues.text: 我冲他们点了点头。没人回应。
cues.textEn: I nodded to them. Nobody nodded back.

cues.text: 很好。至少我知道自己来对地方了。
cues.textEn: Good. At least I knew I'd come to the right place.
